title: 2-Hour Live Music Guided Tour in Key West
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Key West’s best live music with a local guide. Visit 4 music venues in two hours. The Ticket includes, drink discounts, digital guide for upcoming events, digital download of local artists music, and historical overviews of the venues and artists who have left their mark on the island. 

Learn from a local about the diverse music scene and creative island life that continues to inspire so many.
